lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct, high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is broader in the mid-torso region and decreases slightly as the lines approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and fourth vertical lines (counting from the anterior) terminate approximately two-thirds of the way down the torso, failing to reach the lower ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of approximately 4-5 white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, positioned between the dorsal line and the mid-point of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns originate with a lateral-posterior spiral, flaring outward at the mid-section before curving inward and upward to form a lyrate silhouette.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal apical tips is approximately 1.85 times the pixel distance between the horn bases at the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 6% of the total vertical length of the horn structure at the distal apex.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct white V-shaped chevron is visible between the eyes, and prominent white transverse bands are present on the lower limbs above the hooves.
